items.en_title: Itapecerica (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #07
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itapecerica (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 688,484.29; proposals close Nov 24, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
